DMA needs a real DART IOMapper. Bypass is withdrawn. Linux records the Wi-Fi iommu group as translated DMA with one MSI. PureDarwin has no Apple DART IOMapper. No stock PCIe init.

No Broadcom driver and no firmware. IO80211 exists, but cfg80211 FullMAC is stubbed, so brcmfmac cannot sit on it. wifi-source-acquisition.json pinned three reference files only. Firmware, NVRAM, CLM, and txcap were not read. MSI must not fall through to the x86 IOPCIBridge doorbell. Bluetooth stays excluded.
